title: Webhook
description: A webhook subscription that receives Orchestrator event notifications

Id.description: Unique integer identifier of the webhook

Url.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL that receives event POST requests

Enabled.description: Whether the webhook is active and sending notifications

Secret.description: Optional HMAC secret for validating payload signatures via X-UiPath-Signature header

SubscribeToAllEvents.description: Whether to receive all event types or only the specified ones

AllowInsecureSsl.description: Whether to allow webhook delivery to endpoints with invalid SSL certificates

Events.description: List of event type identifiers to subscribe to when SubscribeToAllEvents is false
